key.name: show-badges
key.summary: Show corner badges outside edit mode
key.description: Whether each view's corner badge stays visible outside edit mode.

key.name: migrated
key.description: Set once the v0.2 helpers, grid, and mockup have become a set.

key.name: helpers
key.description: Deprecated: read once by the migration to sets. JSON list of guides and rectangles, in stage pixels.

key.name: show-helpers
key.description: Deprecated: read once by the migration to sets. Whether guides and rectangles stay visible outside edit mode.

key.name: color
key.description: Deprecated: read once by the migration to sets. Color of guides, rectangles, labels, and the column grid, as #rrggbb.

key.name: unit
key.description: css shows CSS pixels at 100% browser zoom; device shows physical screen pixels.

key.name: zoom
key.description: Deprecated: read once by the migration to sets. Browser zoom level, in percent, that CSS pixel values and the column grid assume.

key.name: color-format
key.description: Format the color picker shows and copies.

key.name: mockup-file
key.description: Deprecated: read once by the migration to sets. Path of the image laid over the screen; empty for none.

key.name: mockup-visible
key.description: Deprecated: read once by the migration to sets. Whether the mockup image is shown.

key.name: mockup-opacity
key.description: Deprecated: read once by the migration to sets. Opacity of the mockup image, in percent.

key.name: mockup-density
key.description: Deprecated: read once by the migration to sets. Image pixels per CSS pixel: 2 for an image exported at 2x.

key.name: mockup-position
key.description: Deprecated: read once by the migration to sets. Top-left corner of the mockup image, in stage pixels.

key.name: grid-columns
key.description: Deprecated: read once by the migration to sets. Number of columns in the column grid.

key.name: grid-gutter
key.description: Deprecated: read once by the migration to sets. Space between columns, in CSS pixels.

key.name: grid-margin
key.description: Deprecated: read once by the migration to sets. Padding on both sides of the grid container, in CSS pixels.

key.name: grid-max-width
key.description: Deprecated: read once by the migration to sets. Width of the centered grid container, in CSS pixels; 0 uses the full width.

key.name: edit-shortcut
key.description: Enters and leaves edit mode; empty disables it.

key.name: pick-color-shortcut
key.description: Starts the color picker; empty disables it.

key.name: grid-shortcut
key.description: Shows or hides the column grid over the focused window; empty disables it.
